title: Daily Late Charge Schedule for Independent Living Billing Periods
content:
A daily late charge runs on a past-due billing period of an Independent Living Residency Agreement account and is added to the late fee assessed for that period.

## Counting the days

The daily late charge runs from the day after the grace period ends, the grace period ending 10 days (the grace period of every apartment type) after the posting date of the monthly fee charge of the billing period, and it is counted in calendar days up to and including the day of assessment.

## Schedule

| Days run after the grace period ended | Daily late charge |
|---|---|
| 15 days or more | 60.00, the capped amount |
| More than 5 days but fewer than 15 days | 4.00 for each day that has run |
| 5 days or fewer | None |

The daily late charge is added to the late fee after any reduction of it; the late fee assessed never goes below zero and is rounded once to the cent half up.

## Day table (monthly fee charge posted on the 1st of a 30-day month; grace period ends at the end of the 11th)

| Day of assessment | Days run | Daily late charge |
|---|---|---|
| 12th | 1 | None |
| 16th | 5 | None |
| 17th | 6 | 24.00 |
| 25th | 14 | 56.00 |
| 26th | 15 | 60.00 |
| 30th | 19 | 60.00 |

## Hypothetical example

A late fee of 75.00 assessed on the 21st, for a charge posted on the 1st, has 10 days run and a daily late charge of 40.00, a late fee assessed of 115.00.
